name: tshopper — catalogue and shop as a capability of their own
summary: Phase A: draw the boundary between the service catalogue/shop and the engine inside the single binary, and give product managers, line managers and customer responsibles delivery-SLA, consumption and order reporting.
next_action: Merge the TSH0 charter, then start TSH1 test-first: a product's serviceLevel survives publish and release read and is copied onto the order line.

slices.title: Charter, plan and ADR draft
slices.note: Plan, manifest, ROADMAP entry and ADR-draft-service-reporting-and-customer-views in review.

slices.title: Service level on products and the delivery report
slices.note: serviceLevel {name, deliveryDays} frozen into the release and copied onto the line; off-loop delivery report with lead time, SLA met and overdue; dashboard, CSV, MCP tool.

slices.title: Line-manager and customer-responsible views
slices.note: Team view from managerId; reportingGroups per catalogue with an organisation dashboard showing names and CSV; every read with names audited.

slices.title: tshopper shell and wiki building blocks
slices.note: Shop page carries the tshopper name, app switcher and the dashboards; wiki building blocks listed in the catalogue editor.

slices.title: Boundary contract between shop and engine
slices.note: One contract package the order side reaches the engine through, mapped to TMF620/622/637 (ADR-0387); no behaviour change.
